Here’s the truth: your life doesn’t change when you’re ready. It changes the moment you DECIDE and then take massive ACTION. 

This is YOUR year. This is YOUR time to break through what’s been holding you back, to raise your standards and become who you were truly meant to be. 

Grab your virtual ticket now. Link in bio, or comment “UPW” and I’ll DM you the details. 👊".

557 likes, 127 comments - russellbrunson on October 20, 2026: "We filmed this in 2022. And for four years I’ve been waiting for the right moment to release it.

Not because I wasn't proud of it. But because it was one of the most vulnerable interventions I’ve had.

When @TonyRobbins brought me up for an intervention, I had spent time preparing my question, but I had no idea Tony was about to take it.

This went so much deeper than I expected it to.

It touched my kids. It touched on my faith. It touched the beliefs I've carried with me for most of my life.

And more importantly, it hit some of the more uncomfortable questions we should all be asking - who I am, what I believe, and whether the things I've always held to be true are real.

I've spent years teaching people how to change their lives. How to break through limitations. How to become who they're meant to be.

But this came at me from a blind-spot, and it hit very differently.

There's a reason this footage sat unreleased for four years.

Some moments are harder to share than others, especially when they reveal parts of yourself you're still trying to understand.

Four years later, I'm finally ready to share it.

The full intervention with Tony Robbins is now on my YouTube channel.

Comment YOUTUBE and I'll send you the full video 👇

#TonyRobbins #RussellBrunson #Mindset #PersonalDevelopment #YouTube".

37K likes, 506 comments - greatness on October 15, 2026: "there’s only one reason you’re stressed. 🖤

@tonyrobbins says it’s because you’re managing your circumstances instead of creating your life.

managing feels like holding on. maintaining. just trying to get by. creating feels like building something, and there’s no fear in that.

courage doesn’t mean you’re not scared. it means you’re scared and you do it anyway, trusting it’s all leading somewhere greater.

send this to someone who’s been in survival mode way too long 👇

#schoolofgreatness #tonyrobbins #mindset #faith #personalgrowth".

6,997 likes, 153 comments - tonyrobbins on October 14, 2026: "@sagerobbins and I had the privilege of spending last week in Maui with our Platinum family at Platinum Happiness. ☀️🌺 We spent 5 days learning and growing side by side, exploring happiness and everything it touches: our relationships, the way we handle pain, and the expectations we carry. 

We got to see Maui from the air. 🚁🏔️ We took helicopter rides over the island’s mountains, cliffs and ocean, and it was a chance to take in how much beauty and possibility surrounds us when we stop holding so tightly to our expectations of life.

We also spent time with @themauifarm, an organization that provides resources and support for women and families affected by domestic violence. We painted homes for families starting new chapters. We built garden boxes to bring food security to their campus and community. And we helped bring to life a mural of the hāpuʻu fern, a native plant that unfurls new growth even after the hardest seasons. 🎨🌿🤝

What we get in life won’t make us happy long-term. Who we become and what we contribute will, and we felt that here serving The Maui Farm. 🙏

To our Platinum Partners: thank you. Thank you for the energy you brought, the heart you brought, and the love and contribution you poured into others. It’s a true gift to share moments like these with you. 🤟❤️".
